points.description: First process correctly named AND described (e.g. passive transport/diffusion: higher to lower concentration; osmosis: diffusion of water; facilitated diffusion/protein channels: membrane controls pathway for specific particles; active transport/pumps: uses energy, against gradient, low to high; or membrane-assisted transport: endocytosis/exocytosis/phagocytosis/pinocytosis with vesicles). Equivalent wording accepted.
points.partial_credit: Half marks if the process is named correctly but the description is missing or incorrect/vague.

points.description: Second, different process correctly named AND described, as per the accepted list in P1.
points.partial_credit: Half marks if the process is named correctly but the description is missing or incorrect/vague.

points.description: Third, different process correctly named AND described, as per the accepted list in P1.
points.partial_credit: Half marks if the process is named correctly but the description is missing or incorrect/vague.

rubric.notes: Each of three distinct valid processes earns 1 mark for a correct name plus description. Name only or weak description earns half. Repeats of the same process (e.g. endocytosis and phagocytosis as separate) should be judged strictly; distinct listed processes count separately.
